snippets.title: Dockerfile básico (Node/Python genérico)
snippets.description: Multi-stage simple, cachea dependencias
snippets.code:
FROM node:20-alpine
WORKDIR /app
COPY package.json pnpm-lock.yaml ./
RUN corepack enable && pnpm install --frozen-lockfile
COPY . .
RUN pnpm build
EXPOSE 3000
CMD ["pnpm", "start"]

snippets.title: docker-compose.yml de ejemplo
snippets.description: App + base de datos Postgres
snippets.code:
services:
  api:
    build: .
    ports:
      - "3000:3000"
    environment:
      DATABASE_URL: postgres://user:pass@db:5432/app
    depends_on:
      - db
  db:
    image: postgres:16-alpine
    environment:
      POSTGRES_PASSWORD: pass
    volumes:
      - db-data:/var/lib/postgresql/data

volumes:
  db-data:
